info.title: ky-ai-browser — read a served app's browser console (and drive it) from an AI agent over MCP.
info.description: Browser/runtime console capture for AI agents: attaches to a running ky-ai-ng and exposes the served app's console over MCP.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription:
Run it next to a running `ky-ai-ng serve`:
ky-ai-browser [options]

options.name: --project
options.description:
Which ky-ai-ng frontend to attach to (default: the only one registered).
Also the name this capture registers under in the hub.

options.name: --name
options.description: Override the hub registry name (default: the attached frontend's name)

options.name: --hub-port
options.description: ky-ai-browser hub port to register with (default: 5104; auto-started)

options.name: --ng-hub-port
options.description: ky-ai-ng hub port to discover the frontend (default: 5101)

options.name: --rest-port
options.description: This instance's own control/ingest port (default: OS-assigned)

options.name: --no-hub
options.description: Standalone: host capture locally only; no hub, no agent access

options.name: --yes
options.description: Skip the inject confirmation (default answer is yes anyway)

options.name: --started-by
options.description:
continues the launcher's start-up box instead of opening its own, and
skips the inject confirmation (being launched is itself the opt-in).
